change.title: Move set_mode Science wait outside AppState with owner CAS
change.summary: Extends the existing process-local Science stop owner boundary to set_mode. The official-mode transition claims the exact owner and typed stop request under AppState, executes the existing stop policy without AppState, and publishes only after generation and complete owner CAS. A stale result preserves replacement Science state, the tracked Gateway, and the prior durable mode.

basis: set_mode and stop_all share one process-local owner claim and publication implementation while retaining their distinct Gateway and error semantics

the R1 regression separately exercises generation-only and identity-only drift, proves AppState remains readable during the stop wait, and rejects stale publication without changing config or stopping the tracked Gateway
the existing R0 set_mode characterization continues to freeze journal preflight, stop failure, and config-commit failure ordering
the static Science runtime boundary binds lock-before-claim inside the shared helper and claim-execute-relock-publish ordering in both set_mode and stop_all
set_settings and every other Science stop owner remain outside this bounded slice
